description: Remove audio tracks while copying the video stream into a new container. Review the silent video before publishing. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: video_mute
title: Remove audio from video
